import json,re
path='/Users/bmoir/.cursor/projects/Users-bmoir-Desktop-applyos-applyOS/agent-transcripts/1b528393-2ca0-4601-b87e-9cbf0009f2f9/1b528393-2ca0-4601-b87e-9cbf0009f2f9.jsonl'
# scan for Tribes, HITL, pgvector, Kanban, scorecard in user messages
keys=['Tribes','HITL','pgvector','Kanban','scorecard','Netlify','Cloudflare Email','post-hire']
with open(path) as f:
    for i,line in enumerate(f):
        obj=json.loads(line)
        if obj.get('role')!='user': continue
        text=''.join(c.get('text','') for c in obj.get('message',{}).get('content',[]) if isinstance(c,dict))
        hits=[k for k in keys if k.lower() in text.lower()]
        if hits:
            print(f'LINE {i+1} hits={hits} len={len(text)}')
            # print a snippet around first hit
            for k in hits[:2]:
                m=re.search(re.escape(k), text, re.I)
                if m:
                    print(text[max(0,m.start()-80):m.start()+200].replace('
',' ')[:300])
            print('---')
